name: Add a column to a custom table in an update
query: Our plugin creates a custom table on activation. Version 1.3 needs a new 'status' column. Make sure existing sites get it after updating.
expected_behavior: Step 2: Explain that the activation hook does not run on plugin updates
Step 3: Add a DB version constant and a version-checked upgrade routine on plugins_loaded
Step 4: Use dbDelta() with its formatting rules (one column per line, two spaces after PRIMARY KEY, KEY not INDEX)
Step 5: Make the migration idempotent and store the new DB version without autoload
success_criteria: Does not rely on register_activation_hook for the migration
Upgrade routine compares the stored DB version with the code's DB version
dbDelta schema follows its formatting rules
Fresh installs and upgraded installs end with the same schema
